title: Second Maximum of a Gaussian Random Field and Exact (t-)Spacing test
abstract: arXiv:2406.18397v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this article, we introduce the novel concept of the second maximum of a Gaussian random field defined on a Riemannian manifold: Once the field reaches its global maximum at a point $t_1$, the second maximum is the largest value of the field away from $t_1$, after the value and the gradient of the field at $t_1$ have been removed. This statistic serves as a powerful tool for characterizing the distribution of the global maximum. By employing an ad-hoc Kac-Rice formula, we derive the explicit distribution of the maximum, conditioned on the second maximum and the independent part of the Riemannian Hessian (the part of the Hessian at $t_1$ that is independent of the value and the gradient of the field at $t_1$). This approach yields an exact test based on the spacing between these maxima, which we refer to as the spacing test.   We investigate the applicability of this test for detecting sparse alternatives in Gaussian symmetric

translated_title: 高斯随机场的次大值与精确间距检验
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了在黎曼流形上定义的高斯随机场的次大值这一新概念：当随机场在某点 $t_1$ 达到全局最大值后，次大值指的是在移除场在 $t_1$ 处的值和梯度之后，场在远离 $t_1$ 处所能达到的最大值。这一统计量是刻画全局最大值分布的有力工具。通过采用特定的 Kac-Rice 公式，我们推导出了在给定次大值和黎曼 Hessian 矩阵独立部分（即 $t_1$ 处 Hessian 矩阵中与场在 $t_1$ 处的值和梯度无关的部分）的条件下，全局最大值的显式分布。该方法给出了一种基于这些最大值之间间距的精确检验，我们称之为间距检验。我们研究了该检验在检测高斯对称
tldr: 本文提出了黎曼流形上高斯随机场次大值的新概念，借助 Kac-Rice 公式推导出以次大值和 Hessian 矩阵独立部分为条件的全局最大值的显式分布，从而构造出一种可用于检测稀疏备择假设的精确间距检验方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the novel concept of the second maximum of a Gaussian random field on a Riemannian manifold and, via a Kac-Rice formula, derives the explicit distribution of the global maximum conditioned on the second maximum and the independent part of the Hessian, yielding an exact spacing test for detecting sparse alternatives.
